name: s81su_smh-s81su_smh-COMMIT
purpose: S81U-2: per-head SM cluster of the S81-DV regional service slice (gate; bit-exact gate su_gate.py run --hier --smu with -DSU_SMU_T).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_su_t_smh u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/su_sm/dsfd_su_t_smh.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81su_smh/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81su_smh/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81su_smh --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_su_t_smh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smc_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smc --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smd_u65_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smd --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_sml_u65_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_sml --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smr_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-2 (S81-DV p4h): the per-head SM cluster (one per regional service slice, x16, hardened once): 16 lanes + sum + root + 8 divide engines as their closed native-PASS views (sml_u65, smd_u65, smc, smr), SRL relay glue between them; replaces the 2-head SM stop of the old SU slab (ot_s81_su_sm 1231x1058 band unit). g2 (10-17 tile review): pins moved from the short W face (726 um, the slice's W/E neighbour side) to the long S face (1,030 um, 1.36 pins/um) toward the head's tap ot_s81_su_smq and the svc part of the slice (place MX for an N-facing tap); glue band along S, lanes 4x4 + divide 2x4 re-placed on the 43.2 lattice; outline 1030x765 (1.35:1, was 1.49:1), deepest child 741 um from the pin face (was 1,050).
